scenarios.title: Add New Product to Inventory
scenarios.description: Verify that a user can successfully add a new product to the inventory with all required fields.
scenarios.testDescription: Check if the product addition process works as intended by entering valid data in all mandatory fields.
scenarios.prerequisites: User must be logged into an account with inventory management privileges.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the 'Inventory' section.
2. Click on the 'Add Product' button.
3. Enter a valid product name, SKU, price, and quantity.
4. Click 'Save' or 'Submit'.
scenarios.expectedResult: Product appears in the inventory list with the entered details, and a confirmation message is displayed.

scenarios.title: Reject Product Addition with Missing Required Fields
scenarios.description: Ensure that the system prevents adding a product if required fields are missing.
scenarios.testDescription: Attempt to add a product leaving one or more required fields (e.g., product name, SKU) empty.
scenarios.prerequisites: User is logged in and on the 'Add Product' page.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Leave the product name field empty.
2. Enter valid values in other fields.
3. Click 'Save' or 'Submit'.
scenarios.expectedResult: Product is not added and a validation error message appears indicating required fields.

scenarios.title: Edit Existing Product
scenarios.description: Verify the ability to edit details for an existing product in inventory.
scenarios.testDescription: A user updates an existing product's price and quantity.
scenarios.prerequisites: At least one product exists in the inventory.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Locate and select a product from the inventory list.
2. Click on 'Edit'.
3. Change the price and quantity.
4. Click 'Update' or 'Save'.
scenarios.expectedResult: Product information updates in the inventory and reflects the changes.

scenarios.title: Delete Product from Inventory
scenarios.description: Ensure that a product can be deleted and is removed from the inventory list.
scenarios.testDescription: The user removes a product from the inventory and confirms the deletion prompt.
scenarios.prerequisites: At least one product present in the inventory.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Select a product from the inventory list.
2. Click on 'Delete'.
3. Confirm deletion in the popup dialog.
scenarios.expectedResult: Product is removed from the inventory list and no longer appears.

scenarios.title: Search Products by Name
scenarios.description: Verify that searching for products using the name field returns correct results.
scenarios.testDescription: A user enters a full or partial product name in the search bar to find products.
scenarios.prerequisites: Inventory contains multiple products with distinct names.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the inventory search bar.
2. Enter a product name or partial name.
3. Click 'Search'.
scenarios.expectedResult: Inventory list displays products matching the search query.

scenarios.title: Prevent Duplicate SKU
scenarios.description: Ensure that the inventory system does not allow products with duplicate SKU codes.
scenarios.testDescription: Attempt to add a new product using an SKU that already exists in the inventory.
scenarios.prerequisites: Inventory contains at least one product; note the SKU.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Go to the 'Add Product' page.
2. Enter the existing SKU in the SKU field.
3. Fill other fields with valid data.
4. Click 'Save'.
scenarios.expectedResult: A validation error appears indicating the SKU already exists, and product is not added.

scenarios.title: Validate Price Input Format
scenarios.description: Check that the system only accepts price inputs in a valid numeric format.
scenarios.testDescription: Verify that entering invalid price formats (letters, negative numbers) is not accepted.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Enter a non-numeric value or negative number in the price field.
2. Complete other required fields with valid data.
3. Click 'Save'.
scenarios.expectedResult: A validation message appears, and the product is not added.

scenarios.title: Inventory Load Performance
scenarios.description: Measure performance when loading inventory with a high volume of products.
scenarios.testDescription: Inventory page is opened when the product count is at its maximum supported threshold.
scenarios.prerequisites: Inventory database is pre-populated with maximum number of products (e.g., 10,000 items).
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Login as authorized user.
2. Navigate to inventory page.
scenarios.expectedResult: Inventory page loads within 2 seconds and remains responsive.

scenarios.title: Session Timeout Handling
scenarios.description: Ensure that the user session expires after a period of inactivity.
scenarios.testDescription: User remains idle on the application for the session timeout duration.
scenarios.prerequisites: User is logged into the inventory system.
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Remain inactive for the configured session timeout period (e.g., 15 minutes).
2. Attempt to perform any action after inactivity.
scenarios.expectedResult: User is redirected to the login screen, and a session expired message is displayed.
